title: ATM Cash Withdrawal & Mandatory PIN
scenario: At an ATM, a Bank Customer wants to "Withdraw Cash". However, the bank security protocol strictly requires that every cash withdrawal MUST verify the user’s PIN ("Verify PIN") as an inseparable, mandatory sub-flow.
goal: Create an Association from Bank Customer to "Withdraw Cash", and an «include» relationship from "Withdraw Cash" to "Verify PIN".
learningObjective: Learn the «include» relationship. It represents mandatory behavior extracted into a common use case. The dashed arrow ALWAYS points from the base use case TO the included use case.
hints: The Bank Customer initiates "Withdraw Cash", so draw an Association between them.
Is PIN verification mandatory for cash withdrawal? Yes! Use «include».
The arrow for «include» points from the base ("Withdraw Cash") toward the included case ("Verify PIN").
solutionExplanation: The «include» relationship is used when a base use case unconditionally delegates to or requires another use case. The arrow points from the base use case to the included one, labeled «include».

solutions.description: Customer associates with Withdraw Cash, which includes Verify PIN
